author: MYSTICWIND24
quote: For all the hype surrounding Leonida, Grand Theft Auto VI really falls flat with its characters and story. Lucia starts out with clear motivation, but her arc quickly gets repetitive, and Jason feels way too passive—he barely drives the plot forward as a co-lead. Most of the side characters come off as loud clichés instead of actual satire, so the big emotional moments just don't land. On top of that, the pacing drags hard thanks to tedious errands and hyper-realistic busywork between missions. Instead of taking real risks, the story relies on predictable crime tropes, leaving an incredible open world weighed down by dull writing.
